extract_page

Returns the readable text of one HTML document, with tables rendered as rows and preformatted blocks kept as written.

pub fn extract_page(html: &Html, max_chars: usize) -> String

Parameters

NameTypeDescription
html&HtmlA parsed document
max_charsusizeUpper bound on the returned characters

Returns

The readable text, truncated with an ellipsis when it exceeds the bound.

Example

let document = Html::parse_document(&body);
let text = extract_page(&document, 4_000);

Notes

The bound applies after the container is chosen, so a long article is not lost to a shorter sibling.
